content.meaning: edits#125 Input<α>+Context<C> -> P<α,β> -> heterogeneous Candidate<β>* -> one cmp -> Selection -> existing Decision<β>. α,β remain open; alphabet/current-line prefix are only examples.
content.adoptionScope: No accepted canonical adoption authority established for this open design or source description.
content.applicability: Original heterogeneous typed input proposal across α/β kinds. Current Vim is a limited replaceable prefix Query, not a universal interpreter.
conditions: At least two distinct β candidate kinds arise from one Input/Context and enter the same cmp.
Retain β and hand to separately owned existing Decision; do not claim Vim implements it.

satisfaction.description: Given one Input<α>/Context<C>, compare two different Candidate<β> types in one cmp, preserve β through Selection and the existing Decision boundary.

refutation.description: Fixed one alphabet/β, lost β after selection, or claim native insertion itself as accepted Decision.

content.meaning: Candidate<β>=Meaning+Representation<β>+Evidence+optional Effect; same Meaning may project to text(jp/eng), sem, function, math or graph. Equal label/score does not imply same meaning; keep original β and separate Effect.
content.adoptionScope: No accepted canonical adoption authority established for this open design or source description.
content.applicability: Full proposed typed candidate model, not merely the installed semcmp text catalog.
conditions: Preserve typed Meaning, Representation, Evidence and optional Effect independently.
One Meaning can have several projections; preview must not execute optional Effect.

satisfaction.description: Distinguish same label/score different meanings and same meaning different representations while retaining β, Evidence and separate optional Effect.

refutation.description: Conflation of label with meaning, deletion of β/evidence, or implicit Effect execution from menu preview.

content.meaning: ADRS#484 proposes Vim+LSP as typed Readline-like intent UI, intent -> graph-capability candidates -> Jev probabilistic rank -> verify/execute -> reusable typed function/graph; edits#125 separates typed Selection and Decision. Current Vim modifies Working only.
content.adoptionScope: No accepted canonical adoption authority established for this open design or source description.
content.applicability: Proposed Voice/Vim/browser typed intent/Decision lifecycle, not just native string insertion.
conditions: Human can compare original candidate meaning/β/evidence before choice.
Jev ranking, verification/execution and reusable capability remain external responsibilities.

satisfaction.description: Trace typed intent, graph candidates, Jev ranking, verify/execute and reusable capability through separate owners while preserving Selection->Decision type.

refutation.description: Treat preview or text insertion as the already verified/executed function graph or an accepted Decision.

content.meaning: ADRS#481 proposes Windows WSLC/OCI Vim -> in-edits Python LSP {Jev, subprocess} -> exact bins/agents, Astral CPython, Herdr PTY-only and HQ/gosh-like runtime retirement. Actual base distributes a direct semcmp CLI.
content.adoptionScope: No accepted canonical adoption authority established for this open design or source description.
content.applicability: Historical ideal only; adoption UNCONFIRMED and no current Python-LSP implementation mapped.
conditions: Keep Python LSP/Jev/subprocess and Herdr PTY-only roles distinct.
Do not substitute the installed semcmp CLI for unimplemented proposed LSP.

satisfaction.description: If adopted, Vim would connect to Python LSP/Jev/subprocess to bins, Herdr limited to PTY and HQ runtime absent from that path.

refutation.description: Wrongly claim the current CLI fulfills the Python-LSP design, or omit the Herdr/PTY and HQ retirement boundary.

content.responsibility: First findstart clears pending/base, snapshots source/buffer/changedtick/full Working/current/context/cursor and Query/Acquire Funcrefs; calls Query on deepcopy, requires exact {start,input}, number in [0,cursor.col-1] on UTF8 byte boundary and Unchanged snapshot/callbacks; otherwise echo/-3. Second call consumes pending once, validates native span removal/prefix/cursor/other lines/source/current/context/callbacks, calls ValidateView(Acquire(deepcopy(raw))) then rechecks state; needs exactly one group matching opaque current/context. Items map word(join text by newline), abbr(label), menu(provenance), optional/default info, user_data(handle), dup/equal/empty=1. Stale/error -> [] with scoped echo.

content.responsibility: Require binary/catalog. readfile(catalog,'b') parses list of exact {id,meaning,representation}, trimmed nonempty string id/representation, unique IDs, opaque meaning. Query {input,state:{current,working:full lines,context},focus:{line,column,start}}. Shell-free system([binary],JSON); reject nonzero shell_error/changed catalog bytes (not ABA-proof). Result exact {query,proposals,evaluation}, typed same query, equal count, unique matching IDs and original meaning/representation; evidence exactly {theme:'intent-fit',noul:numeric 0..1}. Same compares Number/Float numerically but distinguishes numeric strings. Preserve result order; map multiline text/first-line label/score provenance/info and original full proposal as handle, then ValidateView.
